s1.syndrome_frame: A firm mass in the breast with a history of previous breast cancer treatment, fixed to the pectoralis major muscle
salient_findings: 20 mm firm mass fixed to the pectoralis major muscle
Focal asymmetrical density in the retromammary space on mammography
Lobulated, well-defined mass with heterogeneous internal echoes on ultrasonography
key_facts: 59-year-old woman
Previous breast-conserving surgery with endocrine therapy and radiation to the left breast
Previous carcinoma in the upper inner quadrant of the left breast
Firm mass in the lower outer quadrant of the left breast
Mass fixed to the pectoralis major muscle
Overlying skin uninvolved
No palpable axillary lymph nodes
Mammography showed a focal asymmetrical density
Ultrasonography revealed a lobulated, well-defined mass
Core-needle biopsy suggested atrophic mammary glands
Lesion increased in size on three-month follow-up

shortlist.label: Post-Radiation Sarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: History of radiation therapy to the breast and development of a new mass

shortlist.label: Leiomyosarcoma
shortlist.why_kept: Firm mass fixed to the pectoralis major muscle, consistent with a sarcoma

shortlist.label: Recurrence of Breast Carcinoma
shortlist.why_kept: Previous history of breast carcinoma and new mass in the same breast

shortlist.label: Malignant Fibrous Histiocytoma
shortlist.why_kept: Considered in the differential diagnosis of a sarcomatous mass in the breast

shortlist.label: Phyllodes Tumor
shortlist.why_kept: Lobulated, well-defined mass on ultrasonography, consistent with a phyllodes tumor

raw.rationale: The patient has a history of radiation therapy to the left breast, and the current lesion is in the same breast, which increases the likelihood of post-radiation sarcoma. The mass is also fixed to the pectoralis major muscle, which is a common feature of sarcomas.

rejected.label: Leiomyosarcoma
rejected.why: While possible, leiomyosarcoma is rare in the breast and the patient's history of radiation therapy makes post-radiation sarcoma more likely

rejected.label: Recurrence of Breast Carcinoma
rejected.why: The core-needle biopsy suggested atrophic mammary glands, and there is no clear evidence of carcinoma recurrence

rejected.label: Malignant Fibrous Histiocytoma
rejected.why: This is a type of sarcoma, but post-radiation sarcoma is more specific to the patient's history and presentation

rejected.label: Phyllodes Tumor
rejected.why: The mass is fixed to the pectoralis major muscle, which is not typical of phyllodes tumors, and the patient's history of radiation therapy points more towards post-radiation sarcoma
